en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a small town square with alpine mountains in the background. On the right stands a large church-like building with arched windows and a bell gable; to the left are multi‑story houses with red-tiled roofs forming a street edge. In the foreground is a grassy open area with a few small trees. The printed caption at the top reads "SPORMAGGIORE — Piazza".
